easyPrerequisites: You control three or more creatures.
description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Dundoolin Weaver.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Dundoolin Weaver that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Dundoolin Weaver token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dundoolin Weaver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.

uses.name: Astral Cornucopia
uses.cardState: with three or more charge counters on it
